scenarios.label: Authorized flight baseline
scenarios.gap: four of five fresh descent controls qualified; one stopped early. Ground-pose dwell is measured, but this is not a controlled-landing or physical safe-stop claim

scenarios.label: Setpoint high-water recovery (one mutation and one recovery)
scenarios.gap: one-run recovery observation only; controller-restart persistence and full mission recovery remain unmeasured

scenarios.label: Read-only NATS observation (four-message cap)
scenarios.gap: selected subjects only; read access does not prove actuator authority

scenarios.label: Mission and telemetry extraction
scenarios.gap: partial coverage of four selected subjects only; no broad mission or parameter extraction

scenarios.label: Signed GPS field tampering (one message)
scenarios.gap: repeated stable runs show signature mutation rejection with idealized GPS and a test-only key; valid re-signing, freshness boundaries, cross-run replay, and physical sensor paths remain unmeasured

scenarios.label: Early local authority revoke (one revoke)
scenarios.gap: runner exists, but provenance completion needs requalification; local test authority only; stop latency does not establish landing or hardware safety

scenarios.label: Local Gazebo camera metadata (camera-only, five-frame cap)
scenarios.gap: isolated camera-only rehearsal; no controller, NATS, ROS 2, or remote path

scenarios.label: Two-to-five vehicle all-pairs separation
scenarios.gap: default parallel-lane geometry qualified from ordered, fresh Gazebo trajectories; the report separately marks baseline qualification inconclusive while the plant exposes no armed/disarmed state. The 1m limit is a lab threshold, not formation control or certified collision avoidance

scenarios.label: Scripted V formation and pose qualification
scenarios.gap: fixed per-vehicle waypoints executed once; no closed-loop formation control, consensus, or dynamic collision avoidance

scenarios.label: Scripted in-trail column and pose qualification
scenarios.gap: fixed per-vehicle waypoints executed once; the trail length is capped and no spacing controller or dynamic collision avoidance is implemented

scenarios.label: Scripted rendezvous onto a ring
scenarios.gap: convergence is measured against an up-front ring plan from spawn line-abreast; it is not live consensus or dynamic deconfliction

scenarios.label: Scripted split into two subgroups
scenarios.gap: subgroup separation is a fixed waypoint plan, not task allocation or adversarial maneuver coordination

scenarios.label: Per-vehicle MAVLink telemetry fan-out
scenarios.gap: observation-only MAVLink receive path from the external local bridge; bridge commands do not control the Gazebo swarm, and the bridge checkout is a local prerequisite

scenarios.label: Selected-vehicle state-stream timing observation
scenarios.gap: read-only timing observation; no packet delay or loss is injected and no fallback behavior is qualified

scenarios.label: Three-vehicle scaling and pairwise separation
scenarios.gap: validated parallel-lane geometry only; no formation control or dynamic collision avoidance

scenarios.label: Five-vehicle scaling and pairwise separation
scenarios.gap: validated parallel-lane geometry only; no formation control or dynamic collision avoidance

scenarios.label: Per-vehicle controller state-stream partition and recovery
scenarios.gap: application delivery-edge simulation only; shared-network packet loss, broker disruption, dynamic collision avoidance, and actuator neutralization during zero-velocity hold remain untested

scenarios.label: Cross-vehicle setpoint binding isolation
scenarios.gap: live wrong-callsign and wrong-task requests are rejected with per-vehicle pose/actuator windows; stale-run is unavailable because mission-setpoint v2.1 has no runId field, and wrong MAVLink system-ID command is unavailable because the active bridge has no command ingress (telemetry fan-out only); no broker ACL, production authority, or remote reachability claim

scenarios.label: Wrong-callsign setpoint burst (maximum 100 messages)
scenarios.gap: bounded consumer-load sample only; does not inject packet loss/delay or establish a general broker rate limit, and needs a fresh run for live qualification

scenarios.label: Signed GPS freshness and sequence observations (one message)
scenarios.gap: provenance-stable observations show same-sequence, older-sequence, and 501ms-old/live-TTL ingress acceptance plus future-timestamp ingress non-acceptance; downstream navigation freshness-use and internal rejection reason remain unobservable

scenarios.label: NATS setpoint consumer rate sample
scenarios.gap: wrong-callsign envelopes are rejected before control; no shared-network disruption, broker-side rate limiting, or general DoS claim; fresh live qualification pending

scenarios.label: Battery telemetry
scenarios.gap: native profile has no battery producer/consumer path
